examples.name: SettingsCard
examples.summary: Field rows inside a flush Card: typed fields sit in a right cell capped at the 3xs container (`field`), and a textarea drops under the copy at the full measure (`stacked`).
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Card from '@aziontech/webkit/card'
  import Input from '@aziontech/webkit/input'
  import Item from '@aziontech/webkit/item'
  import SettingRow from '@aziontech/webkit/setting-row'
  import Textarea from '@aziontech/webkit/textarea'
  import { reactive } from 'vue'

  const form = reactive({ companyName: '', taxId: '', billingEmails: '' })
</script>

<template>
  <Card :padded="false">
    <template #content>
      <Item.List>
        <SettingRow
          title="Company Name"
          description="The legal entity that owns this account."
        >
          <Input
            v-model="form.companyName"
            size="large"
            class="w-full"
            aria-label="Company Name"
          />
        </SettingRow>
        <SettingRow
          title="Tax ID"
          description="The tax identification number of the entity that owns this account."
        >
          <Input
            v-model="form.taxId"
            size="large"
            class="w-full"
            aria-label="Tax ID"
          />
        </SettingRow>
        <SettingRow
          title="Billing emails"
          description="Billing is forwarded to every address listed here. Separate each one with a semicolon ( ; )."
          kind="stacked"
        >
          <Textarea
            v-model="form.billingEmails"
            class="w-full"
            :rows="3"
            aria-label="Billing emails"
          />
        </SettingRow>
      </Item.List>
    </template>
  </Card>
</template>

examples.name: CompactRows
examples.summary: Login settings: two switches and a Manage button, each at its natural width against the right edge (`compact`).
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import Card from '@aziontech/webkit/card'
  import Item from '@aziontech/webkit/item'
  import SettingRow from '@aziontech/webkit/setting-row'
  import Switch from '@aziontech/webkit/switch'
  import { reactive } from 'vue'

  const form = reactive({ allowSocialLogin: true, enforceMfa: false })
</script>

<template>
  <Card :padded="false">
    <template #content>
      <Item.List>
        <SettingRow
          title="Allow social login"
          description="Users linked to the account can log in with their social network credentials."
          kind="compact"
        >
          <Switch
            v-model="form.allowSocialLogin"
            aria-label="Allow social login"
          />
        </SettingRow>
        <SettingRow
          title="Enforce multi-factor authentication"
          description="MFA is required on login for every user linked to this account."
          kind="compact"
        >
          <Switch
            v-model="form.enforceMfa"
            aria-label="Enforce multi-factor authentication"
          />
        </SettingRow>
        <SettingRow
          title="Authenticator devices"
          description="Manage the devices and recovery codes registered for this account."
          kind="compact"
        >
          <Button
            type="button"
            label="Manage"
            kind="outlined"
            size="medium"
          />
        </SettingRow>
      </Item.List>
    </template>
  </Card>
</template>

examples.name: WithMessage
examples.summary: A Name row after Save was pressed with it empty: the input carries its required state and the HelperText message sits under it in the control column.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Card from '@aziontech/webkit/card'
  import HelperText from '@aziontech/webkit/helper-text'
  import Input from '@aziontech/webkit/input'
  import Item from '@aziontech/webkit/item'
  import SettingRow from '@aziontech/webkit/setting-row'
  import { reactive } from 'vue'

  const form = reactive({ name: '' })
</script>

<template>
  <Card :padded="false">
    <template #content>
      <Item.List>
        <SettingRow
          title="Name"
          description="Give a unique and descriptive name to identify the resource."
        >
          <Input
            v-model="form.name"
            size="large"
            class="w-full"
            aria-label="Name"
            placeholder="office-ranges"
            autocomplete="off"
            required
            aria-describedby="resource-name-message"
          />
          <HelperText
            id="resource-name-message"
            kind="required"
            label="This field is required."
          />
        </SettingRow>
      </Item.List>
    </template>
  </Card>
</template>
